text: Option C: scope/import-aware qualified call resolution (module::helper, crate::free, bare Type::method). Deferred from 088.003-T/088.004-T on shipment 081-S: these forms need import/use resolution + module-tree analysis to prove workspace ownership and avoid re-export/collision false edges. Self::method() already ships as the sound subset. Requires: per-file use-graph, module path resolution, and re-export tracing before promotion.

Option C hardening requirements identified by Copilot review of PR #248 (must all land before any qualified/method call resolution can ship soundly): (1) canonical module/type identity for impl-method index names AND call targets (use-graph + module-path resolution + re-export tracing) so Self::/Type:: resolution cannot mis-resolve across same-named types or same-type different-spellings; (2) unforgeable internal Self marker (sentinel or typed field) so a source qualifier like Self::Assoc::method() cannot forge the marker; (3) consistent generic-parameter normalization for Type<T>::method index names; (4) parser/index-format fingerprint bump or upgrade-triggered reindex so the feature materializes on existing DBs (content-hash skip otherwise hides it). Ties to stash 8CCB9CC3.
